name: ktjs-dom-kit-npm-versions
description: Source of truth for npm package versions used by the Kotlin/JS build. Read by build.gradle.kts and updated by Dependabot. The browserslist entry is found by walking up from the generated site directory: without it Babel has no targets, downlevels async/await to a regenerator state machine, and `@docusaurus/theme-mermaid`'s `if (__DOCUSAURUS_MERMAID_LAYOUT_ELK_ENABLED__)` guard stops being dead code — the build then fails on the optional `@mermaid-js/layout-elk` peer that is deliberately not installed.
